input: Image and prior image-only geometry; no reference quantities or external palette RGB

repeatedGlyphStack.note: Grouping labels come from automatic same-image legend reading; reconstructed OCR is independent but groups themselves are provisional. No matching code recovered.

unlabelledClusters.note: Unlabelled diagnostic clusters; not colour-code or bead-count truth.

stage: failed exploratory sampling; never merged into usage candidates
evaluation: Compared only after output to64 visible independently read reference entries; full reference remains unavailable
conclusion: No method meets per-colour count tolerance. Image-internal font comparison independently restores the remaining visible legend entry; that is not successful body sampling.

inversePixelBlur.note: Three regularised inversions of the repeated-cell pixel stacks; ringing and non-matching text remain. No recovered glyph was admitted as a code.

localGeometry.sampling: Same most-chromatic-pixel + bounded neutral-mixing estimator for all geometry variants
localGeometry.note: Paired comparison with the same 64 automatic same-image anchors and same 43264 hypothetical geometric cells; unlike prior 63-anchor exploration. Quantity evaluation occurs only after prediction. Neither tested local correction improves count accuracy; this does not rule out all other geometric methods.

forwardGlyphFit.note: Four locally installed fonts, two glyph heights; 48 cell observations from each of 12 populous unlabelled RGB clusters. Compare pixel-area-integrated glyph templates at observed phases after row-mean removal. All first/second different-label gaps are below 0.009, so no label is accepted. This is a closed set of 64 visible automatic legend labels and cannot recover missing-legend codes; no independent ground truth for cluster identities is available.

sharedPixelField.limitation: Shared neutral ink/rule field is approximate; most-chroma phase fixes an otherwise unidentifiable background scale and offset. Counts are diagnostic only.
sharedPixelField.conclusion: The model predicts held-out pixels better but yields no colour-count pass among 64 visible references. Rejected; lower pixel reconstruction loss is not evidence of correct colour identity or count.

finitePaletteGlyphFit.note: Single Linux diagnostic run, only 12 groups of 48 cells are matched against labels, not all geometric cells individually. The body clustering/legend stages are included in whole-process metrics. Templates are streamed and existing font files reused; no production assets or code added.

finitePalettePositiveControls.note: 148-cell development original resized, with known same-code cell groups supplied only to make an optimistic word-matching diagnostic. Neither automatic grouping nor full-diagram counting is tested. Not new samples, not acceptance; poor performance limits this method, not all possible algorithms.

displayPaletteAgreement.purpose: Read-only agreement diagnostic; display RGB not accepted as a colour-code/count truth
displayPaletteAgreement.nearestDiagnosticNote: Matches of 64 clear, already decoded legend swatches against all 221 display-reference RGB entries. This measures palette/rendering disagreement, not body sampling accuracy. Affine fit excludes the target code before ranking all 221.

fixedWordWidthDiagnostic.basis: The independent 148 original has roughly fixed code width; three-character print is shorter in height than two-character print. This corrects the prior fixed-point-size template assumption.
fixedWordWidthDiagnostic.note: No reliable target code/count recovered. Halves agreeing on a best code is insufficient without independent identity/coverage evidence. Controlled grouped-word diagnostics do not count as full diagram acceptance.
